newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - OCT 16.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - OCT 16.

text.p: 8These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:

- The session of the Coalition Reconciliation Council soothed tension between the two parties of the ruling coalition. The Free Democrats and the Socialists agreed that the institutional framework of interest reconciliation within the coalition should be widened.
- Marta Tocsik, an adviser in the focus of the privatisation scandal was repeatedly absent from a0hearing of the Parliament's constitutional committee.
-The police finished questioning Marta Tocsik at dawn. Tocsik was helpful to the police.

- Germany's Bayernwerk AG, which had invested some 500 million marks in0Hungary's energy sector, said it had confidence in the Hungarian market and did not plan a legal action against the Hungarian state as some press reports suggested.
